name: @qf-jarvis/postgres-execution-replay-store
description: QF Jarvis durable execution replay / idempotency store (QFJ-P09.03, ADR-0091). The PostgreSQL implementation of the ExecutionReplayGuard that QFJ-P09.02 deliberately left injected and defaultless, turning a process-lifetime promise into a durable fact that survives restart. One conditional INSERT is the arbitration write; two INDEPENDENT database uniqueness constraints -- on executionIntentId and on idempotencyKey -- decide a concurrent race, and a losing caller reconciles READ-ONLY in a new statement and snapshot. Exact replay writes nothing; any durable contradiction fails closed as conflict; database uncertainty THROWS so the dispatch boundary refuses rather than guessing. Transport-neutral: the Core->n8n wire protocol remains PROPOSED and nothing here is an endpoint, header, credential, workflow id or provider client. Stores only the three bound values -- never an ExecutionIntentV1 payload, recipient, contact detail, consent or credential. No tenant scope, no TTL or retention, no retry loop, no clock, no execution authority. Depends on @qf-jarvis/execution-dispatch-runtime (types only) and pg.
